*agent-to-agent conflict resolved through compact and submit*

- **Name:** `c2-two-agents-disagree-third-resolves`
- **Decision:** decided: the expectations are the wanted behaviour ([Open and decided](../decisions.md))
- **Tiers:** ci
- **Covers:** [C2 Disagreement without a human](../catalogue.md#c2)
- **Actors:** `a1` agent, client `agent-alpha` · `a2` agent, client `agent-beta` · `a3` agent, client `agent-gamma` · `h` human
- **Length:** 10 steps over 3 days from 2026-03-01
- **Source:** [`internal/eval/testdata/scenarios/c2-two-agents-disagree.yaml`](https://github.com/kKEo/memors/blob/master/internal/eval/testdata/scenarios/c2-two-agents-disagree.yaml)

## Why it exists

C2 — Two agents disagree, a third resolves. Two agents record conflicting facts about one subject with no human involved; lint reports the contradiction; a third agent takes the conflict item from compact and keeps one fact. Allowed, because both facts are agent trust. The audit names the resolver, the loser is invalidated (history keeps it), the raw rows are untouched and the conflict does not come back.

<summary>c2-two-agents-disagree.yaml (95 lines)</summary>

```yaml
# C2 — Two agents disagree, a third resolves. Two agents record conflicting
# facts about one subject with no human involved; lint reports the
# contradiction; a third agent takes the conflict item from compact and keeps
# one fact. Allowed, because both facts are agent trust. The audit names the
# resolver, the loser is invalidated (history keeps it), the raw rows are
# untouched and the conflict does not come back.
name: c2-two-agents-disagree-third-resolves
description: agent-to-agent conflict resolved through compact and submit
decision: decided
tiers: [ci]
covers: [C2]
clock: 2026-03-01
actors:
  a1: {kind: agent, client: agent-alpha}
  a2: {kind: agent, client: agent-beta}
  a3: {kind: agent, client: agent-gamma}
  h:  {kind: human}
steps:
  - at: 0d
    actor: a1
    op: ingest
    args:
      namespace: platform
      content: |
        # Quorum Replication

        Quorum Replication acknowledges a write when a majority of replicas have it. It requires an odd number of nodes.
      source: {uri: https://plat.example/replication, title: Quorum Replication, kind: doc, origin: web}
    bind: doc

  - at: 0d
    actor: a1
    op: remember
    args: {namespace: platform, statement: "Quorum Replication needs three nodes.", about: [Quorum Replication], evidence_uri: $doc.chunk}
    bind: three

  - at: 1d
    actor: a2
    op: remember
    args: {namespace: platform, statement: "Quorum Replication needs five nodes.", about: [Quorum Replication], evidence_uri: $doc.chunk}
    bind: five
    expect:
      audit: [{op: remember, actor: agent-beta, channel: tool, target: $five}]

  - at: 1d
    actor: h
    op: lint
    args: {namespace: platform}
    expect:
      lint: {namespace: platform, has: [contradiction]}

  - at: 2d
    actor: a3
    op: compact
    args: {namespace: platform, kinds: [conflict]}
    select: {kind: conflict, subject: quorum}
    bind: item
    expect:
      out: {items.0.kind: conflict}

  - at: 2d
    actor: a3
    op: submit
    args: {item_id: $item, keep: $five, reason: "a majority of an odd count; five is the production setting", dry_run: true}
    expect:
      out: {applied: false, dry_run: true}
      audit_none: true

  - at: 2d
    actor: a3
    op: submit
    args: {item_id: $item, keep: $five, reason: "a majority of an odd count; five is the production setting"}
    expect:
      out: {applied: true}
      audit: [{op: resolve_conflict, actor: agent-gamma, channel: tool, target: $three}]

  - at: 2d
    actor: h
    op: history
    args: {uri: $three}
    expect:
      out: {entries.0.uri: $three, entries.0.live: false, entries.1.uri: $five, entries.1.live: true}

  - at: 2d
    actor: a1
    op: search
    args: {query: Quorum Replication nodes, granularity: fact}
    expect: {top: [$five], excludes: [$three]}

  - at: 3d
    actor: a3
    op: compact
    args: {namespace: platform, kinds: [conflict]}
    expect:
      count: 0
```

</details>
